answer.evidence: Sudden total loss 17 Oct 22:00: Rx -11.8 to -40 (LOS floor) while Tx power/bias stable, ruling out TX. OTDR from A ends at 18.197km fibre and from B ends at 13.164km fibre with no light beyond; sum equals total fibre, proving same single break. Proportional mapping to 30.48km route gives ~17.7km between SC-03 (13.668) and SC-04 (19.484), consistent with road-works report around km20. No continuity => fibre_break not bend.
